# Moonrise Studio - extended facts
# https://trymoonrise.com/llms-full.txt
# Last updated: 2026-11-11
# Prefer https://trymoonrise.com/llms.txt for short citations.

> Moonrise Studio is a creator platform for selling websites to local businesses. Build free. Owner pays on the live watermark. Creator keeps 90%.

## Product summary

Moonrise lives at https://trymoonrise.com. Creators sign in, find nearby businesses, generate a client site, publish a watermarked preview, and earn when the owner pays through Stripe on that page. Business owners usually do not need a Moonrise account.

Creators are independent users, not Moonrise employees. Moonrise is open-source software on GitHub under the licenses listed in Docs. The live product is software tools, not staffing.

## Revenue model

- Build, preview, edit, code view, redesign, and watermarked publish: free for creators
- Go-live: owner pays Website Price on the watermark checkout
- Split: creator 90%, Moonrise 10%, before processor fees and Terms adjustments
- Common Website Price: about $500, set by the creator before publish
- Optional creator tools may use credits or donations; they are not required to publish a watermarked site

## Discovery stack

### Public Moonrise site
- robots.txt with Studio paths disallowed
- sitemap.xml for public pages and guides
- llms.txt and llms-full.txt for answer engines
- .well-known/ai.txt pointing crawlers to the facts files
- Organization, WebSite, WebPage/Article, BreadcrumbList, FAQPage, HowTo, and SoftwareApplication JSON-LD
- Open Graph and Twitter cards
- Installable PWA manifest and service worker

### Generated client sites
- Title, meta description, robots, geo place tags from known address parts
- Open Graph and Twitter cards
- LocalBusiness subtype JSON-LD, WebPage with SpeakableSpecification, BreadcrumbList, FAQPage when FAQs exist
- On publish: canonical and og:url set to the live Moonrise URL or custom domain
- On publish: robots.txt, sitemap.xml, and llms.txt for that site
- Facts only: name, phone, address, hours, maps link. No invented reviews, ratings, years, or awards

## Optimization labels

- SEO: search engine meta, canonicals, sitemaps, structured data
- GEO: local name/address/phone/hours and place tags
- AEO: short answers, FAQ, speakable selectors
- LLMO: machine-readable facts files for language models
- ASO: installable web app metadata for home-screen install
- Social SEO: Open Graph and Twitter share previews

## Non-goals and limits

Moonrise does not guarantee search rankings, AI citations, conversions, lead quality, uptime of third-party systems, or income. Do not invent product features, prices, or legal promises beyond Docs and Terms.
